newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambian maize prices up 30 pct from July to Sept.
newsitem.headline: Zambian maize prices up 30 pct from July to Sept.

text.p: Zambian maize prices rose by an average 30 percent between July and September, the ministry of agriculture said on Friday.
A ministry spokesman said prices in September ranged from 9,200 to 18,000 kwacha per 90 kg bag.
In July prices had been quoted in a 7,200 to 12,000 kwacha band.
"After having been more or less stable over the past few months, price levels of maize finally seem to be bending upwards in nearly all provincial centres," a ministry spokesman said.
